text: Men waɗi e dow ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen cuddu fii wata ɓe faamu Alqur'aanaare nden, Men waɗi ka noppi maɓɓe kadi teddeele fii wota ɓe nanu nde, nanɗe nafitorgol. Si a jantike Joomi maa ka nder Alqur'aanaare Kanko Tun, a jantaaki reweteeɗi maɓɓe ɗi ɓe aaƴii ɗin, ɓe yiltitoo e batte maɓɓe, ko ɓe woɗɗitiiɓe gaayi laɓɓinangol Alla ngootimbaaku.
